demo_extraction.scope_summary: Replace the core banking platform across 150 branches. Migrate customer accounts and integrate with national payment switches. Provide 24x7 production support for three years.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must have a minimum of 15 years in business.

eligibility.requirement: Core banking at three commercial banks
